text:
Mei: FYI NorthRidge just uploaded a vendor risk form and highlighted three blockers for renewal: embeddings retention (they want 90-180d options), insistence on BYOK provenance for hosted, and strict non-prod masking. They asked for concrete answers in 4 business days. PDF attached.

Ben: can you paste the exact Qs? quick triage first.

Mei: Copied from form:
- Can tenant-level embeddings retention be set to 90 or 180 days?
- Can you support BYOK for hosted tenants and provide key provenance/HSM attestation?
- What are your non-prod data handling controls; can you provide masked sandbox options and subprocessor list?
- Confirm SOC2 scope: which regions and infra vendors are included.

Priya: Security takeover: I'll run BYOK + infra vendor scope. Short answer: hosted does not provide customer-managed keys today. BYOK available for Private/Dedicated only. We can provide KMS vendor list and rotation logs. Need to know if they require HSM attestation vs KMS audit logs.

Sam: Legal will prepare DPA language that offers retention extension via addendum plus a BYOK compatibility clause (explicitly call out hosting constraint). Will need confirmation of what we can commit to technically.

Tanya: CSMs: please hold off on telling customer BYOK is available for hosted until legal + security confirm language. I'll coordinate the 1:1 call.

Ben: Embeddings retention is configurable per-tenant with a default 30d. Ops can flip to 90/180 for enterprise accounts with a contractual exception. I'll get the config doc and the redacted audit trail.

Ben: ops snippet for engineers:
```bash
curl -X PATCH https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/NR-123 \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"embeddings_retention_days":180}'
```

Priya: For SOC2 infra evidence I need the vendor table (DB, object store, monitoring, logging, CDN) and links to our third-party SOC2 attestations. @Mei please attach onboarding vendor list.

Mei: Uploading onboarding artifacts now -> https://drive.internal/northridge/onboard_artifacts (attachment). DPA Bot also logged the PDF at /evidence/northridge/2026-03-vendor-form.pdf sha256: c3f4...

DPA Bot: Document uploaded: /evidence/northridge/2026-03-vendor-form.pdf (automated).

Sam: Proposed timeline: Security and Ops post evidence by Tue EOD, Legal drafts DPA addendum by Wed EOD, internal review Thu, customer comms Fri. Customer deadline ~2026-04-08.

Tanya: I'll schedule a 30m readout demo for the customer once we have a short options memo. Also will add a feedback question about docs - they found retention docs unclear.

Priya: Action items (security): 1) Confirm KMS vendors & provide rotation log excerpts 2) State clearly that hosted BYOK is unsupported and list migration path to Private/Dedicated 3) Confirm whether masked sandbox (data pseudonymization) templates meet their bar. I'll post links here.

Ben: I'll attach ops artifact: https://internal/ops/embeddings/retention-change-2026.zip (redacted logs + config).

Sam: Legal note: if customer insists on hosted BYOK, escalate to Sales for dedicated/private pricing and timeline. That's a commercial blocker and renewal risk.

Mei: Marking renewal risk = moderate-high. Adding acct owner to loop once we have draft language.

Tanya: I'll prepare the customer one-pager outlining 3 paths: 1) standard hosted (30d) 2) hosted + contractual 90/180 exception 3) migrate to Private/Dedicated with BYOK. Include estimated timelines and cost delta.

Priya: Quick question for the group: does anyone have an HSM provenance template? If not, we can offer our KMS attestation + available logs but not HSM cert for hosted.

Ben: No HSM for hosted. We can provide KMS audit trails and rotation metadata.

DPA Bot: Reminder set: internal follow-up 2026-04-06 09:00 UTC for signoff.

Mei: Thanks team  will update the customer ticket and set expectation for our response window.
